28:36.text: But when Moses came to them with Our signs as clear evidences, they said, "This is not except invented magic, and we have not heard of this

28:37.text: And Moses said, "My Lord is more knowing
of who has come with guidance from Him and to whom will be succession in the home.

28:38.text: And Pharaoh said, "O eminent ones, I have not known you to have a god other than me. Then ignite for me, O Hāmān,
and make for me a tower that I may look at the God of Moses. And indeed, I do think he is among the liars."

28:39.text: And he was arrogant, he and his soldiers, in the land, without right, and they thought that they would not be returned to Us.

28:40.text: So We took him and his soldiers and threw them into the sea.
So see how was the end of the wrongdoers.

28:41.text: inviting to the Fire, and on the Day of Resurrection they will not be helped.

28:42.text: And We caused to overtake them in this world a curse, and on the Day of Resurrection they will be of the despised.

28:43.text: And We gave Moses the Scripture, after We had destroyed the former generations, as enlightenment for the people and guidance and mercy that they might be reminded.
